title: Exponential Growth Arithmetic, Population and Energy, Dr. Albert A. Bartlett
summary: A recording of physicist Albert Bartlett's well-known lecture on the arithmetic of exponential growth, applied to population and energy use. He argues that steady percentage growth in a finite world cannot continue and sneaks up suddenly.
why: Treated as the classic lecture on why people misjudge exponential growth, and pulled out in threads on compound growth, epidemics, crypto and resource limits.

quote.text: The point is well illustrated in the talk, I highly recommend it.
